$comment: GENERATED from Pydantic (schema_version 1.2.0). Do not edit.

AssemblySnapshot.description: Layered build-up. Walls list layers exterior→interior; floors/roofs/ceilings top→bottom.
AssemblySnapshot.title: AssemblySnapshot

DesignFinishes.description: Interior finish materials (material-library ids; render appearance + future costing).
DesignFinishes.title: DesignFinishes

DesignRecord.description: The design decisions a model was generated with (self-contained; K3).
DesignRecord.title: DesignRecord

DesignSystemSnapshot.description: An approved design system as copied into a model (self-contained, like type snapshots).
DesignSystemSnapshot.title: DesignSystemSnapshot

Door.description:
Door hosted by a wall (relationship hosted_by).

position is in HOST-WALL-LOCAL coordinates: x = offset of the opening's start edge from the
wall start along the axis, y = 0, z = 0 (door sill). rotation is unused (zeros).
Door.title: Door

FacadeMaterial.description: High-level facade choice; the layout engine maps it to material-library ids.
FacadeMaterial.title: FacadeMaterial

FacadeSide.description:
Semantic facade of the house (building/facades.py). The street is on the model's south
side (-y): front = street/entrance side, rear = garden/backyard side, left/right as seen
from the street.
FacadeSide.title: FacadeSide

Furniture.description: Furniture/fixture placeholder. position = base center on the floor.
Furniture.title: Furniture

FurniturePalette.description: Furniture materials by slot (placeholders use these material ids).
FurniturePalette.title: FurniturePalette

Level.description: A storey ("floor"). elevation = finished floor level (FFL) above level 0 FFL.
Level.title: Level

Railing.description: Guard rail. position = start of its base line; runs along local +x.
Railing.title: Railing

Roof.description: Roof. position = outline origin; position.z = top of the roof covering at the eaves.
Roof.title: Roof

Room.description: A space (not a solid). position = origin of `boundary`.
Room.title: Room

Rotation.description: Euler angles in radians, XYZ order. Most elements only use `z` (yaw, CCW from +X).
Rotation.title: Rotation

Slab.description:
Structural slab. position = outline origin; the TOP face is at position.z (slab hangs
down by `thickness`).
Slab.title: Slab

Stair.description:
Straight flight. position = bottom corner at the first riser; the flight runs along local
+x (rotation.z) and spans local +y by `width`. n risers, n-1 treads.
Stair.title: Stair

Wall.description: Straight wall. position = axis start point; rotation.z = axis direction.
Wall.title: Wall

Window.description: Window hosted by a wall. position (host-wall-local): x = start offset, z = sill height.
Window.title: Window

app__modules__building__enums__Layer.description:
Discipline layer. Every element belongs to exactly one.

Phase 1 populates architecture, structure and furniture; the others are reserved so the
viewer's layer manager and the schema don't change when MEP/site work lands.
app__modules__building__enums__Layer.title: Layer
